search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Targeted searches located the issuer's 2025 presentation, which supports the listed product-application associations. The presentation does not substantiate the 'core supplier' qualifier or a direct supplier/customer role, so those points remain unresolved rather than inferred.
The primary source is an issuer investor-conference presentation filed on the Taiwan Market Observation Post System.
The presentation labels the brand list as product applications; it does not explicitly identify the brands as direct customers or suppliers.
The category percentages shown are not brand-specific shares, and the slide does not specify a brand-level denominator or measurement period.
